shortDescription: This module manages Hitachi NAS virtual volumes

options.name: api_key
options.description: The REST API authentication key - the preferred authentication method.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the REST API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The URL to access the Hitachi NAS REST API.  This needs to include the protocol, address, port and API version.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the REST API.

options.name: data
options.description: Additional data to describe the virtual volume and its quota. The I(name), I(virtualServerId) and I(filesystemId) parameters are required for all operations. The I(quota) parameter can be used to add or update the virtual volumes quota. The I(remove_content) parameter is only relevant for I(state=absent).

options.name: state
options.description: If I(state=present), ensure the existence of a virtual volume and its quota. If I(state=absent), ensure that a specific virtual volume is not present on the server.
